soil_params.json.transform: None (copied verbatim). One row per primary core (station, depthCm); see the mesonet-soils README.

gdd_stages.json.transform: Keyed by crop; stages with NA gdds dropped and sorted by gdd (as the API does). `stage` is the Haun number for wheat/barley, else a 1-based ordinal; `code` is the published stage label. Corn has no table (empty list).
gdd_stages.json.known_differences: Deployed derived.stages labels hemp stage 1 "BBCH Stage 11"; write_hemp_table.sql says "BBCH Stages 0-11". Vendored from the SQL.
gdd_stages.json.license: Montana Climate Office; stage tables compiled from NDAWN / extension publications.
